title: 15 Million Bats Pour Out of One Texas Cave Every Night

scenes.text: 15 million bats leave this one cave every night.
It's Bracken Cave in Texas, one of the biggest bat colonies on Earth.
They pour out for up to four and a half hours, so dense that weather radar sees them.
Together they eat over 100 tons of insects in one night.
That's roughly the weight of 20 elephants, in bugs.
Fifteen million bats, one cave, every single night.

description:
15 million bats leave this one cave every night.
Bracken Cave in Texas is home to about 15 million Mexican free-tailed bats. They take up to four and a half hours to leave, show up on weather radar, and eat more than 100 tons of insects a night.
Would you watch it in person? Comment below.
first_comment: The bats can fly up to 60 miles out and back in one night to feed. Would you stand under that swarm?
